usedFor: Odoo holds invoices, and “When an invoice is paid” adds a Microsoft Excel row with “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “When an invoice is paid” in Odoo, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: It runs when an invoice is marked paid, so the table lists paid invoices only.

watchOut: “Lead created or updated” fires on edits too, so “Add Row To Table” can add the same lead twice.
